contract.evaluation: Peak within each second, taken at the bin start and at each cast time in the bin
contract.entry_time: Cast event time. For Tailwind the owner reports this is the activation, not the dash
contract.side_asymmetry: Supported entry is attacker-only and pre-plant; answers are defender-only
contract.semantics: Recorded casts by distinct players; no verified effect, landing spot or entry

selection: The owner-annotated windows only; chosen before these channels existed
limitations: Channels were designed from these seven cases; agreement with them is not validation.
Entry markers are two named abilities; in this series one player per team casts them.
A cast is a recorded use, not a confirmed effect, landing spot or duration.
Caster spacing is not the distance between utility effects.
No model consumes these prototype features.
These development rounds are not an independent evaluation set.

none, let me explain: when marved smoked off havoc and kon4n in tree, liazzi used his paranoia, combined with havoc using zero point on tree and then flash driving out of that smoke to refight for the tree space while mwzera switched to holding main, since his team was fighting for tree. in this case, especially on defense, you should not be thinking about strictly how the duelist’s space revolves around the team’s utility, that is more suited for attacking when you need to execute a site. here, it’s more important that liazzi’s paranoia combined with havoc’s zero point then flash drive was used to reclaim the tree space after marved’s smoke.
